title: A handoff cannot carry Roadmap unchanged over an empty roadmap
body:
Why: operator 2026-11-14: knowledge is lost between sessions. The handoff of 2026-11-13 carried "Roadmap: unchanged" while docs/program/roadmap.md had an empty table, so no session saw that the plan was exhausted (fixed by t-72wjf0z dea255f).
Outcome: scripts/claude/handoff-requests.ts refuses `Roadmap: unchanged` when the roadmap table has no row naming an open task, and names the fix (refill the roadmap).
Proof: test/claude/handoff-requests.test.ts with an empty-table roadmap fixture exits non-zero; npm run fast PASS.
